description: Header file for pybind11's type signature concatenation utilities, including template classes and functions for compile-time string manipulation and type info handling.

classes.name: descr
classes.description: Template struct for representing compile-time string descriptions with type information.

classes.name: int_to_str
classes.description: Template struct for converting integers to string descriptions at compile time.

methods.name: plus_impl
methods.description: Concatenates two descr objects at compile time.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Overloaded operator for concatenating descr objects.

methods.name: const_name
methods.description: Creates a descr object from a string literal.

methods.name: io_name
methods.description: Creates a description string for input/output type signatures.

methods.name: operator|
methods.description: Combines descr objects with a '|' separator.

methods.name: operator,
methods.description: Combines descr objects with a ', ' separator, using fold expressions if supported.

methods.name: concat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple descr objects with ', ' separator.

methods.name: union_concat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple descr objects with ' | ' separator.

methods.name: type_descr
methods.description: Wraps a descr object in braces '{}'.

methods.name: arg_descr
methods.description: Wraps a descr object with '@^' and '@!' markers.

methods.name: return_descr
methods.description: Wraps a descr object with '@$' and '@!' markers.
